posts.title: Scary games for kids
posts.description: I have a soft spot for scary games made for kids. Videogames as a medium are not strangers to horror. The market is full of well-designed, really scary games. Anything from classic games like Resident Evil , Silent Hill or Rule of Rose to more modern gems like Dead Space or Amnesia are fantastic examples with tons of fans across the globe.
